messages:
mira: quick heads-up — did a small smoke run comparing FP8 / INT8 / AWQ / GPTQ on a prod-weighted prompt sample (2k queries). want to lock routing + fallback rules before we open a canary. summary below.
ajay: thanks, can you paste the perf/quality numbers? interested in tail latency and any outliers.
mira: pasted raw summary from bench-bot:
```
bench-bot: results (2k sample, token-limited):
- FP8: mean latency=76ms, p95=210ms, cost index=1.00, quality_delta=+0.12% (vs fp16 baseline)
- INT8 (GPTQ): mean latency=64ms, p95=190ms, cost index=0.78, quality_delta=-0.38%
- AWQ: mean latency=62ms, p95=240ms, cost index=0.72, quality_delta=-0.95% (notable hallucination cluster on intent 'dates')
- GPTQ (mixed): mean latency=66ms, p95=170ms, cost index=0.75, quality_delta=-1.75%
notes: goldenset QA F1 drop correlates with AWQ on date-entity extraction; FP8 slightly improves generative fluency on long contexts.
```

lia: useful — what's our golden regression threshold again? iirc we abort canary if mean quality_delta <= -0.5% on golden set or any critical QA F1 drop > 1.0pts.
devin: correct. also watch p95 latency delta > +30ms for hosted profile; that triggers fallback to dedicated or smaller context model.
ryan: proposed traffic corridor: start 3% hosted traffic to INT8 (GPTQ) for initial smoke, 1% to AWQ in parallel but behind strict goldenset gating. if INT8 passes for 24h -> bump to 10%. FP8 goes to dedicated-only route (reserved pool) at 5% for perf-sensitive customers. fallback rules: any goldenset fail -> instant 0% for that variant and route traffic to FP8-hosted-safe (if available) or FP16 baseline.
lia: putting that into a config snippet for the console (pseudo-yaml):
```
routing:
  - variant: int8-gptq
    target: hosted
    initial_pct: 3
    escalates_to: 10
    gating: goldenset: {max_mean_delta: -0.5%}
  - variant: awq
    target: hosted
    initial_pct: 1
    gating: goldenset: {max_mean_delta: -0.25%, abort_on: ["date-entity-f1_drop>1.0"]}
  - variant: fp8
    target: dedicated
    initial_pct: 5
    gating: perf: {p95_increase_ms: 30}
fallbacks:
  - trigger: goldenset_fail
    route_to: fp16-baseline
  - trigger: perf_regress
    route_to: dedicated-fp8
```

ajay: small ask — can bench-bot attach the top 10 failing examples for AWQ so we can craft targeted prompts to probe the hallucination mode?
bench-bot: attached 10 examples to the thread (linked in console run 18405-qa-awq).
mira: thanks. action items: (1) devex to load the routing snippet as a draft in console, (2) infra to reserve a tiny FP8 pool for dedicated canary, (3) bench/QA to run a focused goldenset on the AWQ failure cluster and push failing examples to eval repo, (4) SRE to add an alert: "quant-goldenset-regress" with severity=p1.
devin: noted — will create infra ticket and reserve 2 gpus in dev-dedicated for the FP8 pool.
ryan: I'll run the canary rollout plan doc and add the traffic corridor entries. recommend we keep AWQ at max 2% until targeted fixes.
ops-bot: deploy-plan saved: /console/rollouts/1840500000-quant-smoke. canary windows: 24h initial, 72h extended. auto-fallback hooks enabled.
mira: perfect — quick ask to everyone: please react with :thumbsup: once your action item is done so we can schedule the canary start tomorrow morning PST. :eyes:

ajay: :thumbsup:

lia: :thumbsup:
devin: :thumbsup:

ryan: :thumbsup:

bench-bot: summary metrics pinned to run 18405-qa-awq, tags: ["goldenset", "smoke", "quant"]

mira: closing thread — will open follow-up with canary timestamps when infra PR merges.
